Penalized lavaan Fit Objects (‘plavaan’ Class)

Source: R/plavaan.R
plavaan.Rd

An S4 subclass of the ‘lavaan’ class, defined by setClass("plavaan", contains = "lavaan"). Objects returned by penalized_est() are ‘plavaan’ objects: they carry a ‘penalized’ attribute recording the penalty specification, a shared ‘plavaan.cache’ environment attribute (used to cache the frozen refit), a fitmeasures() method that reports fit indices at the effective degrees of freedom (see effective_df()), and a summary() method that prints the frozen fit's summary together with the effective parameter and degrees-of-freedom counts. Fit evaluation (fitmeasures() and the chi-square test in summary()) is experimental and only available when the fit was created with a non-"none" test (see penalized_est()).
